gateway.title: Welcome to NiniApp
gateway.subtitle: How do you want to use NiniApp?
gateway.androidWarning: When installing the APK file, Android will show a security warning because the application is not published on Google Play. This is normal: tap "More details" and then "Install anyway". If you prefer to check it first (being cautious with downloads is always advisable), you can scan the APK with any virus detector and verify that it is completely safe.
gateway.iosButton: What if I have an iPhone or iPad?
gateway.iosSteps:
APK files cannot be installed on Apple devices. Instead, the web version can be pinned to the home screen and behaves like a regular application:

1. Open this page in Safari.
2. Tap the Share button: the square with an upward arrow in the browser bar.
3. Select the "Add to Home Screen" option and confirm.

From that moment on, NiniApp will appear with its icon on your home screen.
gateway.iosNote: Direct download is only compatible with Android devices. iOS users must use the web version.

help.title: Help
help.intro: This section explains how each part of the application works.
help.eventsBody: Any member can create events from the Calendar; administrators can additionally mark them as special. There are three event types: standard (with voting), casual meetup (no voting or penalties) and special day (festivities, celebrations and birthdays, which only mark the day). In standard events each member votes their attendance with YES, NO or DECIDING. Voting closes a few hours before the event starts (the number of hours is set by its creator). Changing a vote after voting has closed subtracts 5 commitment points. Once the event is over, its creator validates attendance: having voted YES and not showing up subtracts 15 points. When creating an event you can choose its color: random, one saved by the group or any hex code. Past events remain in the history for one month before being deleted.
help.commitmentBody: The commitment percentage (from 0 to 100) reflects each member's reliability with the group's plans. It decreases when receiving penalties and recovers gradually: 0.5 points for each day without fault.
help.counterBody: The group counter records whatever the group decides to count; it is configured by the administrator. The group streak increases when at least one person contributes each day; if nobody contributes on a given day, the streak returns to zero, although the accumulated total is always preserved. Each member also has a personal streak. From the fourth contribution on the same day it is mandatory to attach a proof photo; these photos are deleted after 24 hours.
help.copipointsBody: Copipoints are the group's internal currency: all members start with 100. Only drivers can add or subtract them, from the Drivers Zone. Each member's balance can be checked in the Ranking.
help.driversBody: The administrator designates drivers from the group settings. Each driver has their own car (name, model, color and seats) which they can edit in the Drivers Zone, their exclusive panel.
help.carsBody: When creating an event, cars can be enabled: those of the group's drivers or temporary cars valid only for that event. Only members who voted YES can take a seat, and it is released automatically if they change their vote.
help.pokeBody: The Poke feature allows you to get another member's attention from their profile. The recharge time per person depends on your commitment: 12 hours at 100% and up to 24 hours at 0%. Your current recharge time is shown in the Profile, where receiving pokes can also be disabled.
help.phrasebookBody: The Phrasary (Group tab) keeps the group's memorable quotes, sorted alphabetically by author. Any member can add quotes — from a member or from someone outside — and edit or delete everyone's with the pencil. Each member's quotes also appear on their profile.
help.songsBody: The group's songbook (Group tab) gathers songs with their title and lyrics, stored preserving spaces and indentation. Only the group's musicians (a role the administrator assigns, like drivers) and administrators can add and edit them; everyone can read them.
help.statusesBody: From the Group tab each member can publish a status with text or photo, editable and removable at any time, which expires after 24 hours. People with a status you haven't seen yet show a colored ring; the status is viewed by opening their profile.
help.pollsBody: Any member can create quick polls from the Group tab: title, options, anonymous or open voting and single or multiple choice. The group is notified when one is created and they delete themselves after 24 hours. They don't affect commitment or anything else.
help.birthdaysBody: The Profile has a switch to show your birthday on the group calendar, entering the date in DD/MM format (editable later). With the switch on, your birthday appears every year as a special day on the calendar.
help.colorsBody: In the Group tab you can save colors with their own name (for example "UAB Green") that any member can reuse later, for example when choosing an event's color.
help.groupsBody: Each user can belong to a maximum of three groups and switch the active group from the Profile. Joining a group requires its ID and password, available in the group settings. If the administrator leaves the group, the role passes to the member they designate.
help.suggestionsBody: The suggestion box allows you to send improvement proposals directly to the application's developer from the Profile. Suggestions can be sent anonymously if desired.
help.iosBody: The Android application (APK) cannot be installed on Apple devices; the web version must be used instead. To have it as a regular application, open niniapp.org in Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an upward arrow in the browser bar) and select the "Add to Home Screen" option. The application will be pinned with its icon on the home screen.

v1_1.name: Version 1.1
items: New Group tab gathering all the group features.
A real Phrasary: quotes by author in alphabetical order, which anyone can add and edit; they also show on each profile.
Musician role and group songbook, with lyrics keeping their formatting.
New event types without voting: casual meetup and special day.
Birthdays on the calendar, with a group notice when the day arrives.
24-hour statuses with text or photo, with an unseen indicator.
Polls with a notification that delete themselves after 24 hours.
Selectable event color and named group saved colors.
Drivers' cars can have their own name.
Poke: recharge drops to 12-24 hours based on your commitment and is shown in the Profile.
Notifications arrive in each recipient's language.

v1_0.name: Version 1.0
items: Initial release: groups, calendar with attendance voting, cars, counter with streaks, leaderboard, copipoints, drivers, pokes, push notifications, extra features and more.
